method: Reuse historical ndtr conditional mean/noise marginalization. Average over every existing positive source component and one standard Normal eta coordinate. Hermite128 inverse CDF compared with Hermite256 and independent adaptive quad_vec on[-12,12],whose omitted standard Normal mass is below4e-33.
